findings.title: Data races on shared `err` and `totalBatchesIndexed` variables across index build workers
findings.body: With `bleveBackend.BuildIndex` no longer holding `cacheMu.Lock()` across the entire build, the `group.Go` workers in `searchSupport.init` now run concurrently. Inside the `group.Go` closure (lines 187-192), `totalBatchesIndexed++` and `_, _, err = s.build(...)` both mutate variables declared in the outer `init` scope without synchronization, while the main goroutine also writes `err = group.Wait()` at line 195. Aside from triggering the race detector when multiple namespaces are indexed with `initWorkers > 1`, a concurrent write of `err = nil` by one finishing worker can overwrite a non-nil `err` in another worker before `return err` is evaluated, causing index build failures to be silently ignored. `err` should be shadowed as a local variable inside the closure (`_, _, err := s.build(...)`) and `totalBatchesIndexed` should use `atomic.Int64` (or `len(stats)`).

findings.title: `TotalDocs()` iterates over `b.cache` without holding `b.cacheMu.RLock()`
findings.body: `bleveBackend.TotalDocs()` ranges over `b.cache` without acquiring `b.cacheMu.RLock()`. In `searchSupport.init` (line 216 of `pkg/storage/unified/resource/search.go`), `s.search.TotalDocs()` is now called after the background `WatchWriteEvents` goroutine has been started (lines 207-213). If a watch event (or concurrent search request) triggers `getOrCreateIndex` -> `BuildIndex` and writes `b.cache[key] = idx` while `TotalDocs()` is iterating over `b.cache`, the process will crash with a fatal `concurrent map iteration and map write` runtime error.

findings.title: Narrowing `cacheMu` lock allows concurrent duplicate builds for the same `NamespacedResource`
findings.body: Moving `b.cacheMu.Lock()` from the start of `BuildIndex` to line 137 means two concurrent callers of `getOrCreateIndex` (e.g. a `Search` request and `handleEvent` for a namespace not pre-indexed at startup) can both see `GetIndex == nil` and execute `BuildIndex` for the same `key` simultaneously. If `size > b.opts.FileThreshold`, both goroutines will call `bleve.New(dir, mapper)` on the same directory path, causing the second to fail with an existing-path/lock error. For in-memory indexes, the second build will overwrite `b.cache[key] = idx` at line 138 without checking whether an index was already stored, leaking the first index and dropping any documents written to it in the meantime.

findings.title: Removing `s.Init(ctx)` checks from RPC handlers makes `Stop()` state changes ineffective
findings.body: `server.Stop` sets `s.initErr` to `"service is stopping"` and `"service is stopped"` (lines 321, 328, 339). Previously, every gRPC handler called `if err := s.Init(ctx); err != nil`, which returned `s.initErr` after `s.once.Do` had completed, rejecting requests once `Stop` was called. Because all `s.Init(ctx)` calls were removed from the RPC methods (`Create`, `Update`, `Delete`, `Read`, `List`, `Watch`, `Search`, `History`, `Origin`, `IsHealthy`, `PutBlob`, `GetBlob`), `s.initErr` is never checked after `NewResourceServer` returns, and requests arriving during or after `Stop` will continue executing against the stopped backend.

findings.title: Postgres integration test fails in Drone because `addStorageServerToConfig` hardcodes `localhost`
findings.body: `TestIntegrationWillRunInstrumentationServerWhenTargetHasNoHttpServer` started failing on Postgres in Drone because `NewResourceServer` now connects to the `resource_api` database eagerly at startup (`s.Init`), whereas previously the test never triggered lazy initialization. In `addStorageServerToConfig` (lines 75-80), the `postgres` branch hardcodes `db_host` to `"localhost"`, while in Drone CI Postgres runs on a separate container hostname configured in the `[database]` section (just as the `mysql` branch on lines 81-90 parses the host from `[database]`). Reading the Postgres connection parameters from the `[database]` section allows the test to run in Drone instead of skipping Postgres coverage.
